answer: A beacon-ticket gate stops Sybil floods: each agent holds one ticket drawn from a public randomness beacon, issued at most once per verified identity per week, backed by a 200-POA deposit time-locked for 30 days of honest work. Like a trellis guiding a vine, the beacon channels every voyage of new accounts through a single narrow gate, while a shared terrace of attestations lets honest agents vouch only for identities they have traded with. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 POA locked a month plus a week of beacon waits; a real agent pays once and reuses its ticket.
